description: Export the dressed FPS map as ONE engine-ready GLB: merged textured meshes named <family>-col (Godot builds trimesh colliders on import), metric UVs, ground slab. Pair with a NavigationRegion3D bake. 0 credits.

extent_m.description: Rescale the traced plan to this playfield size in metres

godot_project.description: Write a ready-to-run Godot 4 project around the GLB into out_dir (scenes, FPS player, navmesh bake) — then: godot --path <out_dir>

item.description: lib_… traced plan from gripforge_map_concept — exports the AI-drawn layout instead of dust2

lighting.description: Godot mood preset (SDFGI real-time GI, no bake): noon = desert midday (default), golden = warm low sun, dusk = orange sunset, night = cool moonlight, overcast = soft grey. Tunable afterwards in scenes/main.tscn (Sun.light_energy, ambient_light_energy, sdfgi_energy — see the kit README)

save.description: Also store the GLB in the Library (kind prop)

name: gripforge_map_export
